jobs.description: The jobAt EU Facility Services, the facility label of Covebo, we believe in “Simply well organized.”This means: good housing, clear rules and practical solutions. Together we make sure our international employees feel welcome and can live comfortably during their time in the Netherlands.Because quality is important to us, we are looking for someone who is hands-on, technical and can keep an overview. But we also like to see that you take initiative and have perseverance. As a Housing & Maintenance Worker you will have a very varied, international job where you work independently. You are always in contact with different departments and colleagues, and you contribute to building a world of work that is “Simply well arranged.” You are communicative, stress-resistant, and good at planning and setting priorities. For this role we are looking for a real doer, someone who does not mind rolling up their sleeves to take care of small technical tasks.
